message.content:
This describes a tow-behind golf ball retriever (range ball picker). The CBP ruling N360787 likely classified it under heading 8433 (harvesting machinery) or 8432, or possibly 8436 or 9506.

Golf ball pickers: tow-behind range ball collectors. CBP has classified golf ball pickup machines such as the "Range Servant" under 9506.32 (golf balls and other golf equipment) or 9506.39. The phrase "ground-contact rotating collection discs" suggests a mechanical implement for ground-based collection. Golf equipment under 9506.31 covers clubs; 9506.32 covers balls; 9506.39 covers other golf equipment (HTS 9506.39.0080 "Other"). Ball retrievers are golf accessories, so 9506.39.0080 is the likely fit.

Alternative: 8433.59 for harvesting machines. But golf ball pickers are generally classified in 9506.39 as "other golf articles and equipment". I'll go with that.
